raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

GGUF transformer loading rejects startup LoRA, and runtime LoRA wrapping assumes every base layer has a dense `weight`. This prevents MiniMax-H3 users from combining the GGUF capacity path with a style adapter.

Related to #43313.

## Modifications

- Allow actual diffusion GGUF linears to use the existing dynamic LoRA delta at TP=1. Keep the packed parameter and its offload identity; do not snapshot or materialize a dense base for LoRA.
- Let `auto` select dynamic mode, and reject explicit merging and TP>1 before conversion. Unknown packed formats remain unsupported; the existing one-adapter-per-target restriction remains.
- Cover numerical scaling/bias, packed storage preservation, adapter replacement and disable/reactivation, startup guards, and real layerwise offload with an adapter installed before or after manager initialization.
- Reject full-width AdaLN adapters before installation when a pruned H3 GGUF lacks projection metadata; a failed replacement keeps the active adapter intact.
- Update the H3 cookbook and GGUF constraints.

## Accuracy Tests

182 tests plus 5 subtests passed on H200. Real H3 generation covered startup LoRA, FFN/AdaLN adapters, pruned GGUF, and compile mode; the tested adapter lifecycle transitions restored video/audio latents and MP4 bit-for-bit.

Compile mode has graph breaks and mixes compiled/eager regions; it is **not full-graph compilation** and its output differs from eager. No eager-equivalence or compile-speedup claim is made. These are compatibility/lifecycle checks with one prompt and the listed adapters, not a general perceptual-quality benchmark or coverage of every GGUF variant.

<details>
<summary>Unit tests and static checks</summary>

- 8 new tests passed on H200 with the actual CUDA GGUF decoder, including a regression confirmed failing before the pruned-AdaLN fix.
- 171 existing GGUF/LoRA tests and 3 related H3 adapter checks passed on H200, plus 5 subtests.
- CPU fallback: 7 new tests passed, 1 CUDA-offload test skipped. Ordinary LoRA import/wrapping does not import the GGUF backend.
- Pre-commit, Mintlify build, and broken-link checks passed (build warnings are in unchanged pages).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Full H3 generation: baseline → LoRA enabled → disabled</summary>

Full H3 validation used one H200, the FL2VA `Q4_K_M` transformer, FA/eager execution, and layerwise offload for DiT and the text encoder. After a two-step warmup, baseline → LoRA enabled → LoRA disabled each ran **50 steps**, seed 1101, 1344×768, 124 frames (5.1667 s), with audio. The adapter was `fal/MiniMax-H3-Realism-People-LoRA/h3-realism-people-t2v-i2v-r2v.safetensors`, strength 0.7, applied to 104 layers.

- Enabling LoRA changed video output and audio latents.
- Disabling it restored the audio latents, raw waveform, all decoded video/audio samples, and final MP4 **bit-for-bit**.
- An earlier run with a cold baseline had a tiny audio difference (max 1.59e-5). A warmed baseline taken **before any LoRA was loaded** exactly matched that run's restored audio. The final run added capture-only probes before encoding to check latent and waveform equality; the LoRA implementation was unchanged.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Extended validation: startup, FFN/AdaLN, pruned GGUF, and compile mode</summary>

Additional real H3 validation used the same H200, prompt, seed, output dimensions, audio, and offload settings:

| GGUF / adapter | Execution | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full Q4_K_M / Larry Turbo v4 EMA, strength 1.0 | Startup `--lora-path`, 8 steps, eager | 259 modules: 104 attention, 104 FFN, 51 AdaLN. Disable/reactivate changes then exactly restores video/audio latents and MP4. |
| Full Q4_K_M / Larry Turbo v4 EMA, strength 1.0 | Startup `--lora-path`, 8 steps, `torch.compile` enabled | Actual compilation: 53 graphs and 1,490 generated kernels, with LoRA projection shapes in autotuning logs. Same-mode disable/reactivate exactly restores latents and MP4. |
| Unsloth pruned Q4_K / Realism People, strength 0.7 | Startup `--lora-path`, 50 steps, eager | 104 attention modules. Disable/reactivate exactly restores video/audio latents and MP4. |

The pruned test exposed an admission bug: loading a full-width Larry AdaLN adapter returned success despite input width 2688 versus the pruned model's 8. The regression fails on the pre-fix method. With the fix, replacing the active adapter under the **same nickname** is rejected before mutation; a subsequent full 50-step generation exactly matches the previous video/audio latents and MP4. Valid-adapter output also matches the pre-fix run.

</details>

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<details>
<summary>Observed generation timings and memory (single warmed runs)</summary>

Single warmed observations, not a throughput benchmark or speedup claim:

| State | Server-reported generation time |
| --- | ---: |
| Baseline | 280.92 s |
| LoRA enabled | 288.64 s |
| LoRA disabled | 281.18 s |

Peak sampled device memory for the session was 19,951 MiB on H200. Dynamic LoRA still adds adapter storage and per-step projections.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Reproduction</summary>

```bash
python test/registered/unit/diffusion/test_gguf_lora.py
python -m pytest -q \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_gguf_diffusion.py \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_lora_pipeline.py \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_lora_dynamic_delta_in_gemm.py \
  python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_lora_inference_mode.py

sglang serve --model-path MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 \
  --model-type diffusion --model-variant fl2va --num-gpus 1 \
  --transformer-weights-path leejet/MiniMax-H3-GGUF/minimax_h3_fl2va-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  --attention-backend fa --performance-mode memory \
  --layerwise-offload-components dit,text_encoder \
  --dit-offload-prefetch-size 1 --dit-layerwise-resident-layers 0 \
  --enable-torch-compile false --warmup-mode off --port 30010
```

POST `/v1/videos` with the following body (use 2 steps once for warmup, then 50 for each comparison):
```json
{
  "model": "MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3",
  "prompt": "r34l1sm, close-up of an adult woman in a quiet cafe, warm window light, she smiles gently and says hello, natural skin texture, subtle handheld camera.",
  "seconds": 5, "task": "t2va", "conditions": [],
  "target": {"short_edge": 768, "aspect_ratio": "16:9", "duration_seconds": 5.0},
  "num_outputs_per_prompt": 1, "num_inference_steps": 50,
  "flow_shift": 12.0, "audio_flow_shift": 3.0, "seed": 1101, "quality": "exact"
}
```

Between baseline and adapted requests, POST `/v1/set_lora`:
```json
{"lora_nickname":"realism","lora_path":"fal/MiniMax-H3-Realism-People-LoRA/h3-realism-people-t2v-i2v-r2v.safetensors","target":"transformer","strength":0.7,"merge_mode":"dynamic"}
```
Before the restored request, POST `/v1/unmerge_lora_weights` with `{"target":"transformer"}`.

Resolved HF revisions: base `42ed227ee7df40d41602854ae760620d6eb651fe`; GGUF `d9c4c6312b4728a68a15a35626d84775a6523783`; adapter `039cc8579d7aa357a882d7f4111b25da4f72dccc`.
For the additional startup tests, add `--lora-path <resolved-local-adapter-file> --lora-scale <strength> --lora-merge-mode auto`. Larry uses `larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora/minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors` and 8 inference steps. The compile case changes `--enable-torch-compile` to `true` (default `max-autotune-no-cudagraphs`). The pruned case substitutes `unsloth/MiniMax-H3-GGUF/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned-Q4_K.gguf` and keeps 50 inference steps with Realism People.

Additional pinned HF revisions: Larry `43a74557ac3f6539db8e0f2a959d03feb7a81480`; pruned GGUF `babc040eff0084465460ead58fdb8ec44296f8dd`.
Environment: PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, FlashInfer 0.7.2, Diffusers 0.37.0.
</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add CI-registered unit tests.
- [x] Update documentation.
- [x] Provide accuracy checks and observed generation timings.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #41711206205](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41711206205)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->

+class _Pipeline(LoRAPipeline):
+    def create_pipeline_stages(self, server_args):

+def _device():
+    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

+def _cpu_dequantize(packed, weight_type, dtype):
+    # Substitute only the CUDA dequantization kernel with gguf-py's decoder.
+    # The packed parameter, quant method, wrappers and adapter lifecycle are real.
+    # The Q8_0 CUDA decoder multiplies scale and integer in half2, even for
+    # float32 output. Preserve that rounding in this independent reference.
+    return (
+        torch.from_numpy(gguf.dequantize(packed.cpu().numpy(), weight_type))
+        .half()
+        .to(device=packed.device, dtype=dtype)
+    )
+
+
+def _layer(layer_type=ReplicatedLinear, skip_bias_add=False):
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(7)
+    dense = torch.randn(12, 32, generator=generator)
+    packed = torch.from_numpy(
+        gguf.quantize(dense.numpy(), gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q8_0)
+    )
+    meta = GGUFTensorMeta(
+        int(gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q8_0),
+        tuple(dense.shape),
+        tuple(packed.shape),
+        torch.uint8,
+        "proj.qweight",
+    )
+    kwargs = dict(
+        bias=True,
+        skip_bias_add=skip_bias_add,
+        quant_config=GGUFConfig("unused.gguf", {"proj.weight": meta}),
+        prefix="proj",
+    )
+    if layer_type is not ReplicatedLinear:
+        kwargs["tp_group"] = SimpleNamespace(world_size=1, rank_in_group=0)
+    if layer_type is MergedColumnParallelLinear:
+        layer = layer_type(32, [4, 8], **kwargs)
+    else:
+        layer = layer_type(32, 12, **kwargs)
+    layer.qweight.data.copy_(packed)
+    layer.bias.data.copy_(torch.randn(12, generator=generator))
+    return layer.to(_device())
+
+
+def _pipeline(layer):
+    pipeline = object.__new__(_Pipeline)
+    pipeline._stages = []
+    pipeline.modules = {"transformer": nn.Module()}
+    pipeline.modules["transformer"].add_module("proj", layer)
+    pipeline.server_args = SimpleNamespace(lora_alpha=None, lora_merge_mode="auto")
+    pipeline.lora_initialized = False
+    pipeline.lora_rank = pipeline.lora_alpha = None
+    pipeline.exclude_lora_layers = []
+    pipeline.lora_adapters = defaultdict(dict)
+    for key in (
+        "loaded_adapter_paths",
+        "loaded_adapter_files",
+        "loaded_adapter_configs",
+        "loaded_adapter_fingerprints",
+        "loaded_adapter_alphas",
+        "cur_adapter_name",
+        "cur_adapter_path",
+        "cur_adapter_strength",
+        "cur_adapter_config",
+        "lora_layers",
+        "lora_layers_transformer_2",
+        "lora_layers_critic",
+        "is_lora_merged",
+        "auto_merge_rounding_loss",
+    ):
+        setattr(pipeline, key, {})
+    for name, rank in (("first", 2), ("second", 3)):
+        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(rank)
+        pipeline.loaded_adapter_paths[name] = f"/{name}"
+        pipeline.loaded_adapter_alphas[name] = rank * 2
+        pipeline.lora_adapters[name] = {
+            "proj.lora_A": torch.randn(rank, 32, generator=g).to(_device()),
+            "proj.lora_B": torch.randn(12, rank, generator=g).to(_device()),
+        }

+            args.lora_merge_mode, args.tp_size = "dynamic", 2
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "TP=1"):
+                _validate_gguf_runtime_support(args)
+
+    def test_pruned_adaln_without_projection_rejects_full_width_adapter(self):
+        """GGUF curve metadata used to let incompatible AdaLN deltas be installed."""
+        model = SimpleNamespace(
+            arch=MiniMaxH3DiTArchConfig(time_embed_dim=2, adaln_curve_grid=9),
+            _adaln_precomputed=False,
+        )
+        prefix = "blocks.0.adaln_proj.linear."
+        adapter = {
+            prefix + "lora_A": torch.ones(1, 3),
+            prefix + "lora_B": torch.ones(4, 1),
+        }
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "adaln_basis.*adaln_mean"):
+            MiniMaxH3DiTModel.prepare_lora_adapter(model, adapter)
+
+        full_model = SimpleNamespace(
+            arch=MiniMaxH3DiTArchConfig(time_embed_dim=3),
+            _adaln_precomputed=False,
+        )
+        self.assertIs(
+            MiniMaxH3DiTModel.prepare_lora_adapter(full_model, adapter), adapter
+        )
+        adapter[prefix + "lora_A"] = torch.ones(1, 2)
+        self.assertIs(MiniMaxH3DiTModel.prepare_lora_adapter(model, adapter), adapter)
+        attention = {"blocks.0.attn.qkv_proj.lora_A": torch.ones(1, 3)}
+        self.assertIs(
+            MiniMaxH3DiTModel.prepare_lora_adapter(model, attention), attention
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
